title.narrative: STRENGTHENING THE INSTITUTIONAL CAPACITY OF THE MINISTRY OF ENVIRONMENT

description.narrative: The mandate of the Ministry of Environmental Protection and Natural Resources (MoEPNR) has undergone a significant expansion through the integration of 5 new departments (that used to be stand-alone State Departments) and the introduction of new functions. This represents a major organizational restructuring of the sector and presents both challenges and opportunities to the new minister of environment. The challenge is to operationally harmonize the multiple mandates of different departments within a common accountability framework. The opportunity is improved efficiencies of the internal mechanisms of the ministry that would translate into better service delivery performance. The MoEPNR currently lacks the capacity to implement its new and expanded mandate. In addition the recent move by the Ministry of Finance towards a Medium-term Expenditure Framework (MTEF) provides an added urgency for the MoEPNR to build its capacity to be able to participate in this new performance-based planning initiative once the MTEF is scaled up to all the ministries. The objective of the grant thus is to increase the capacity of the MoEPNR to strengthen its accountability framework and improve performance-based public expenditure management. The purpose of the Grant is to increase the capacity of the Ministry of Environment Protection and Natural Resources (MoEPNR) of Georgia by strengthening its accountability framework and improving its performance-based public expenditure management.
